admission.justification: Binds every future change of the dashboard frame control to message-first moves with a single fallback load.

alternatives.option: Message-first open for every selection while the channel is ready, with a single workspace-and-agent URL fallback load when the message cannot bring the frame to the agent.
alternatives.reason: MIK-R121@v1 rules 4 and 5 with the R5 acceptance: cross- and same-workspace selections move by message with no reload, and the silent frame loads the agent page once.

alternatives.option: A URL load for every selection.
alternatives.reason: Reloads the frame on every selection, also inside one workspace, which the packet names non-conforming.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Message opens prove unable to reach another workspace's agent and the packet is revised.

consequences: Future frame-control changes keep message-first moves and the single fallback load; per-selection reloads stay out.
context: MIK-R121 rule 4 requires one URL fallback load where the message cannot bring the frame to the agent, and the packet's non-conforming examples forbid reloading the frame on selections that a message can carry. Re-sourced successor: supersedes DEC-F63JY2, whose origin named the retired curator alias; this record's origin names the actual worker source entry.
decider: architect (MIK-R121@v1 packet under developer direction D153)

evidence: PaseoChatFrame.test.tsx document page: no-ready naming, no-target silence, chats-page single fallback load with truthful sentence
